source_message.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],

I reviewed the reference videos again and pulled out the original Hindi keywords and pain points, including टाइमिंग, जल्दी वीर्य निकल जाता है, लिंग धीला हो जाता है, शर्मिंदगी, कमजोरी, etc.

Before creating the 10-second concepts, could you clarify the main benefits and claims of Vedicurja? Does it solve the same issues as the products in the references, or does Vedicurja have particular strengths you want me to emphasize?

I want to use the correct product-specific keywords and messaging while preserving the creative approach that helped the reference ads perform well.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Draft 10-sec Concept

0:00–0:03 The husband sits anxiously on the edge of the bed, and his wife realizes that something is troubling him.

Dialogue: "अगर आपकी टाइमिंग कम है... और जल्दी वीर्य निकल जाता है..."

0:03–0:06 The husband appears embarrassed while his wife reassures him.

Dialogue: "...जिसकी वजह से शर्मिंदगी महसूस होती है..."

0:06–0:10 The wife confidently picks up Vedicurja and looks toward him, followed by a close-up of the product.

Dialogue: "तो आपके लिए है Vedicurja..."

This is the first 10-second concept developed from the reference direction. I’m continuing to refine the remaining dialogue and shots so they stay consistent with your winner script and the last reference.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer provides a 10-second concept describing low timing, premature ejaculation, and embarrassment before presenting Vedicurja as the solution.

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],

Here is a quick progress report. The script for the 30 second version has been finalized and follows your reference video beat for beat, with both products appearing together exactly as requested. I’m attaching it so you can see it.
